text:
sam: Heads up 1 CISO wants to trim eu-west audit exports to cut S3 egress. Proposal: sample noisy telemetry (keystore debug + VPC enrichment) to 15% but keep auth/grant events full. Need ops risk call.

elaine: What's considered "noisy" exactly? All flow enrichment fields or only blobs >2KB?

sam: Mainly header blobs, debug keystore traces, and flow enrichment payloads. Not auth/grant/token events. Estimate saves ~1.6TB/day.

bryan: We tried sampling a subset in staging; it hid a sporadic KMS timeout that caused GPU nodes to retry and join slower. Important to have synthetic decrypt probe + quick rollback.

ops-oncall: Runbook stub: toggle sampling flag in configmap, verify canary probe, monitor decrypt_error_rate and join_latency. CLI: 
```
kubectl -n infra-telemetry patch cm audit-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"eu-west-a.sampling":"0.15"}}'
```
Probe: `curl -fsS https://keystore-canary.eu-west/health -d @payload || exit 1`

elaine: Telemetry: add Prom alerts for `keystore_decrypt_error_rate > 0.25%` (5m) and `gpu_node_join_p95_latency` spike. Auto-revert if triggered.

sam: Compliance note: keep 100% for events with fields: user_token, cross_account, grant_id, admin_action. We'll need a short rationale for auditors.

bryan: Also consider switching exporter to snappy + enabling event-level dedupe before changing sampling; could save ~30% with no fidelity loss.

audit-bot: Ticket created SEC-2026-778 assigned sam (owner), ops-oncall (runbook), elaine (telemetry). Link: https://redwood.internal/sec/SEC-2026-778

ops-oncall: Will stage a 72h canary in eu-west-a. Plan: 50% for first 24h, then 25% next 48h if stable. Rehydrate steps included in runbook. Posting runbook draft to ticket in 20m.

sam: Action items recap: bryan -> test exporter compression; elaine -> prometheus rules & dashboard; ops-oncall -> runbook & CLI toggles; i'll draft compliance justification. Meet 0900 UTC if canary starts. :thumbsup:

bryan: ack.

elaine: ack, tagging @compliance for visibility.
